title: Expose the generic report workspace through permission-aware ERP navigation
description: Stage 1 functional reachability defect found during real browser acceptance: app.js dispatches report-configuration but renderMenu only consumes PROFILE.menus, and no seed menu has this code. Isolated admin catalog contains sales-order and receivable yet no visible workspace entry. Add an authorized generic launch point using existing server catalog, without permission expansion or schema/seed changes. No bespoke report, Agent, stage-2 entrance switch, production or secrets changes. Existing Domain/Application/Infrastructure/API contracts suffice.
acceptance_criteria: A user with at least one backend-authorized common report dataset can reach the existing unified reporting workspace from normal ERP navigation after login. Real isolated browser validation proves the admin sidebar currently has no report-configuration entry even though the render route and API are implemented. Integrate one generic entry, not a dedicated report menu per dataset, using current catalog authorization and existing navigation/tab lifecycle. Do not invent a new ERP permission, grant a role/menu or replace old report entries before stage 2.

Users with no authorized datasets receive no actionable report entry; catalog failure, revoked access, logout/login and repeated menu rendering fail closed and do not retain stale entries or duplicate tabs. Backend dataset/owner/recipient/row-column checks remain authoritative. Preserve existing sidebar, menus, tab selection and report request cancellation on leaving the workspace.

Add executable navigation tests for authorized/non-authorized catalogs, failure, logout/re-entry and duplicate prevention, preserving existing UI contracts. Run safe Release build/test and scheduler self-test/contracts; then verify genuine isolated browser login and opening the workspace through the visible entry. Do not claim full first-stage acceptance from that navigation check.
